tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Yehonatan: Yahu, 'Yahweh', + natan, 'has given'. Its root is Hebrew y-h-w-n-t-n. Jonathan, son of King Saul (1 Samuel 18). Jonathan is a Hebrew name meaning “Yahweh has given”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
